entries.title: Ahn'kahet: The Old Kingdom
body: "The heart of the old nerubian empire": Ahn'kahet, the city of the nerubians' ancestors, from whence they came. Arthas and Anub'arak crossed it on their way to Icecrown, fighting living nerubians, and faceless ones, and a terrifying forgotten one.

Now another enemy stirs here: the faceless ones. Little is known of them, but rumour says they answer to an evil power lurking beneath Northrend. The Scourge holds part of the city; the Twilight's Hammer has come too.

entries.title: The Hall of the Conquered Kings
body: A great hall of the old kingdom, now a nursery for the Scourge's nerubian eggs.

entries.title: The Desecrated Altar
body: Where a prince of the San'layn sits behind a shield of power, gathering the relics of a dead empire.

entries.title: The Befouled Terrace
body: A terrace above a glowing fungal bog, where the Twilight's Hammer offers up its own in sacrifice.

entries.title: The Fallen Temple of Ahn'kahet
body: The deepest temple of the old kingdom, where the faceless ones' herald waits, and the walls between mind and nightmare grow thin.

entries.title: Elder Nadox
body: A nerubian sage, once a leader of his people, now the Lich King's servant and guardian of the eggs.

entries.title: Prince Taldaram
body: One of the Darkfallen, the San'layn, come to the nerubian city to siphon its power and collect its relics for the Scourge.

entries.title: Jedoga Shadowseeker
body: An orc, leader of the Twilight's Hammer in the Old Kingdom, and servant of an Old God.

entries.title: Amanitar
body: A great fungal creature of the Shimmering Bog.

entries.title: Herald Volazj
body: A champion of the faceless ones, the n'raqi, and herald of the Old God whose whispers rise from beneath Northrend.
